using Test: @test

function uses_macro(argument::Any)::Any
    @test argument > 0
    return argument
end

function nested(count::Integer)::Integer
    outer = () -> (inner = () -> count; inner())
    return outer()
end

function recursive(count::Integer)::Integer
    again = step -> step == 0 ? 0 : again(step - 1)
    return again(count)
end

function twice(count::Integer)::Integer
    reader = () -> count
    return reader() + reader()
end
